# uzc_template (Resource)

Manages a template in the caller's own account (POST /account/templates), sourced from exactly one of `url`, `virtual_machine`, `blockstorage`, `blockstorage_snapshot`, or `virtual_machine_snapshot`. Distinct from the read-only marketplace catalog exposed by the uzc_templates data source (phase 1). There is no update endpoint, so changing any attribute recreates the resource.

TODO(api): the spec also documents a binary `template_file` upload flow that isn't implemented here, since it can't be exercised without a live account to test against.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Exactly one of url, virtual_machine, blockstorage, blockstorage_snapshot,
# or virtual_machine_snapshot must be set as the template's source.
resource "uzc_template" "example" {
  cloud_provider           = "nimbo"
  name                     = "example-template"
  os_type_id               = "5ec358db-9ef8-11ee-8ec2-5254007314cc"
  image_type               = "Operating System"
  operating_system         = "centos"
  operating_system_version = "8"
  billing_cycle            = "hourly"
  plan                     = "template-storage-per-gb"

  url    = "https://stackconsole.io/images/centos-8.qcow2"
  format = "QCOW2"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `image_type` (String) e.g. "Operating System".
- `name` (String)
- `operating_system` (String)
- `operating_system_version` (String)
- `os_type_id` (String) UUID of the operating system type.
- `plan` (String) Plan slug, usually based on storage size.

### Optional

- `billing_cycle` (String) Billing cycle slug. Falls back to the provider's `billing_cycle` default when unset.
- `blockstorage` (String) Source: slug of an existing uzc_blockstorage volume. Exactly one source field must be set.
- `blockstorage_snapshot` (String) Source: slug of an existing uzc_blockstorage_snapshot. Exactly one source field must be set.
- `cloud_provider` (String) Cloud provider slug. Falls back to the provider's `cloud_provider` default when unset.
- `description` (String)
- `format` (String) Image format (e.g. "QCOW2"), used with `url`.
- `hypervisor` (String)
- `is_dynamically_scalable` (Boolean)
- `is_featured` (Boolean)
- `is_vm_password_required` (Boolean)
- `is_vm_ssh_required` (Boolean)
- `password_enabled` (Boolean)
- `project` (String) Project slug. Falls back to the provider's `project` default when unset.
- `region` (String) Region slug. Falls back to the provider's `region` default when unset.
- `requires_hvm` (Boolean)
- `root_disk_controller` (String) e.g. "ide".
- `template_type` (String) "USER" or "SYSTEM".
- `url` (String) Source: URL to download the template image from. Exactly one source field must be set.
- `virtual_machine` (String) Source: slug of an existing virtual machine. Exactly one source field must be set.
- `virtual_machine_snapshot` (String) Source: slug of an existing uzc_vm_snapshot. Exactly one source field must be set.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same value as `slug`. Used as the Terraform resource ID.
- `slug` (String) Server-assigned slug, used in the delete endpoint's path and for import.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import uzc_template.example <template-slug>
```
